The REST module reaches `ConceptService.saveDrug` in three resource classes, plus one inherited path. Falkon names the core repository `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core`, not `openmrs-core`, so I searched it under that name.

**Direct callers in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`:**

- **`DrugResource1_8.save`** (`openmrs1_8/DrugResource1_8.java:66-69`) is the main `/drug` write path. It returns `Context.getConceptService().saveDrug(delegate)`.
- **`DrugIngredientResource1_11.save`** (`openmrs1_11/DrugIngredientResource1_11.java:169-185`) saves the parent drug after adding the ingredient, so it depends on `saveDrug` returning the drug correctly.
- **`DrugIngredientResource1_11.purge`** (`openmrs1_11/DrugIngredientResource1_11.java:158-164`) removes an ingredient and then calls `saveDrug` on the parent drug.
- **`DrugReferenceMapResource1_10.save`** (`openmrs1_10/DrugReferenceMapResource1_10.java:44-49`) adds a reference map to its drug and calls `saveDrug` on that drug.

**Inherited path:** `DrugResource1_10` extends `DrugResource1_8`, and `DrugResource1_11` and `DrugResource1_12` extend in turn. None of them calls `saveDrug` directly in the grep results, so they inherit `save` from `DrugResource1_8`. I did not open `DrugResource1_11` or `DrugResource1_12` to confirm they don't override `save`.

**Tests in the REST module that would break:** `DrugController1_10Test` calls `conceptService.saveDrug` at lines 133 and 144.

**Core declarations (for context):** the interface method is at `ConceptService.java:180`, and the implementation at `ConceptServiceImpl.java:272-276` delegates to the DAO. Inside core, `ConceptServiceImpl.unretireDrug` (line 332-334) also calls it, but that is not part of the REST module.

I did not open the test file around those lines, so their ranges are single lines taken from the grep output.
